rows.text: I have a good angle of the Valks bench tonight, and really noticable how Juste Jocyte is the first off the bench to high-five teammates and celebrate them.
rows.name: Juste Jocyte

rows.text: Some big minutes coming for the 20-year-old during a tight game in just her second career game.
rows.name: Juste Jocyte

rows.text: Jocyte is available tonight for the Valkyries.
rows.name: Jocyte

rows.text: Valkyries 2025 first round pick Juste Jocyte, warmed up prior to tonight’s game but Natalie Nakase said she is a game time decision to play.
rows.name: Juste Jocyte

rows.text: Juste Jocyte has been listed as active by the Valkyries and is listed as OUT tomorrow in NY as she gets reconditioned.
rows.name: Juste Jocyte
